about.title: About Me
about.paragraph_1: I'm a full-stack product engineer who ships whole products on my own — from infrastructure and DevOps, through backend APIs and databases, to polished frontends and mobile apps. When a product needs AI, I integrate LLMs, agents and MCP servers where they solve a real problem.
about.paragraph_2: Currently, I'm building <nexora>Nexora Group</nexora>, a software consultancy where I deliver end-to-end digital products. I work across the entire stack — React and Next.js frontends, Python and Node.js backends, PostgreSQL databases, Docker infrastructure — and layer in AI when it creates real value.
about.paragraph_3: I'm bilingual (English/Spanish) and based in Dallas, TX, working remotely worldwide and in person around Dallas–Fort Worth. Whether you need someone to take a product from zero to production, add AI capabilities to an existing platform, or just an experienced engineer who ships — I'm open to the conversation.

ai_setup.meta_title: I set up the AI you already pay for
ai_setup.meta_description: I connect the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot you already pay for to your email, WhatsApp and calendar, and leave it running. Free 30-minute call. Dallas–Fort Worth and remote, in English or Spanish.

hero.title: I set up the AI you already pay for so it does real work, not just chat.
hero.subtitle: I sit with you, look at how your week actually runs, and connect your ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Copilot to your email, WhatsApp and calendar. Then I leave it running, and it's yours. No course, no prompt list.

examples.title: Four things it can take off your plate

admin.title: Your admin panel, without the busywork
admin.text: Connected to your company's admin or internal tools, it finds the products or records you need, pulls them together and builds the spreadsheet. You check the result.

inbox.title: Your inbox, sorted every morning
inbox.text: It reads what came in, tells you what needs an answer today and drafts the replies in your tone. You read them and hit send.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp answers and follow-ups
whatsapp.text: It checks who is still waiting on you and writes the replies, one per person, ready to send from WhatsApp Web.

meeting.title: Meeting recording → minutes and invite
meeting.text: Record the call on your phone. It writes the minutes with decisions and owners, and creates the next calendar invite for the right people.

story.label: A real case
story.text: A project manager at a marketplace startup was spending a lot of her time in the company's admin, searching products one by one and copying them into spreadsheets, and she told me she was afraid of AI. On a call I showed her how to connect her AI to that admin. Now it does the searching and builds the sheets while she checks the result; the afternoon it started working, she used it so much she hit her plan's usage limit. Less than two weeks after our first call she recorded a meeting and had it write the WhatsApp message, the email minutes and the calendar event. She changed three small things and sent everything.

call.title: A free 30-min call, on your screen
call.text: You show me how your week runs, with the AI you already have. Nothing sensitive needed; an overview is enough.

setup.title: I set it up within the week
setup.text: Instructions in your voice, connections to your email, calendar and WhatsApp, and limits so nothing goes out without your OK.

handover.title: A hand-over session on your setup
handover.text: An hour together: you run it on your real work while I watch, and you keep a one-page cheat sheet.

yours.title: It's yours
yours.text: Your accounts, your subscription, your passwords. I stay on chat for the "can it also do this?" questions.

offer.label: Founding clients

consent.text: I use cookies to see which parts of this site help and to measure my ads. If you reject them, I still count the visit, but without cookies or session recordings.

privacy.meta_description: What leogcode.dev collects, why, and which services help: PostHog, Meta, Google Ads, Calendly and the ones that keep the site running.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This site is run by Leonel Guerrero. This page explains what it collects, why, and which services help process it. Paid work is contracted and billed through Nexora Group LLC, which has its own privacy policy at nexoragroup.dev.

form.title: What you send me
form.text: When you use the contact form I receive your name, email, the kind of work you are looking for and your message, plus anything else you add. I use it only to answer you and to follow up on that conversation.

analytics.title: Analytics (PostHog)
analytics.text: PostHog (PostHog Inc., United States) shows me how the site is used: pages viewed, clicks, how far you scroll, which sections you see, and form and booking events, together with the ad campaign parameters of the link you arrived from. Until you accept cookies, and if you reject them, it runs without cookies or local storage and without recording your session. If you accept, it keeps an identifier in a cookie and in local storage and may record your session (what appears on screen, with everything you type masked).

ads.title: Ad measurement (Meta and Google Ads)
ads.text: Only if you accept cookies. The Meta pixel (Meta Platforms) and the Google Ads tag (Google) tell those platforms when a visitor who came from one of my ads books a call, sends the form or opens WhatsApp, so I can see which ads work. Both set their own cookies (such as _fbp and _gcl_au) and process this data under their own privacy policies.

booking.title: Booking a call (Calendly)
booking.text: When you click a booking button, Calendly's scheduling page (Calendly LLC, United States) opens over this site, loaded from calendly.com. Calendly receives the details you enter and the campaign parameters of the link you arrived from, and tells this page when a call is booked so I can count it. Calendly's own privacy policy applies to the booking.

cookies.title: Cookies and your choice
cookies.text: I ask before using any analytics or advertising cookie. Your choice is saved in your browser's local storage so you are not asked on every visit. You can change or withdraw it at any time; withdrawing deletes the identifiers stored by PostHog, Meta and Google on this site.

services.title: Services that keep the site running
items: Vercel hosts the site and Cloudflare serves its domain; Cloudflare Web Analytics counts visits without cookies.
Sentry receives error reports. Its session replay, a masked recording of the page when something breaks, runs only after you accept cookies.
Resend delivers the emails sent from the contact form.
Odoo, my CRM, stores contact requests (when it is connected) so none get lost.
Upstash keeps a short-lived count of form submissions per IP address to stop spam.

retention.title: How long I keep it
retention.text: Contact requests stay in my email and CRM while we are in touch and for a reasonable time after. Analytics data stays in PostHog for the retention period of my plan there. I delete either on request.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You can ask for a copy of your data, ask me to correct or delete it, and object to its use. Write to the address below and I will answer within 30 days. If you are in the EU or the UK you can also complain to your data protection authority.
